offering_description.value: Broadridge delivers shareholder communications, proxy voting, and regulatory disclosures for public companies, funds, and financial intermediaries. It also sells software and outsourced operations to banks, broker-dealers, wealth managers, and asset managers for trading, settlement, and investment administration. It delivers these offerings through hosted platforms, processing networks, and print and digital distribution.

primary_products.value: Governance and compliance software; capital markets software; wealth management software; investment management software; fund data and analytics

primary_services.value: Proxy distribution and vote processing; investor communications and disclosure distribution; transfer agency; outsourced securities operations; software implementation and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Public companies, fund sponsors, asset managers, banks, broker-dealers, wealth managers, and retirement plan providers

end_markets.value: Corporate governance and shareholder communications; investment funds and asset management; capital markets and securities brokerage; wealth management; retirement services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Proxy materials, investor mailings, and securities processing charged by volume; subscription: Recurring access to hosted financial software, data, and analytics; service fees: Transfer agency, outsourced operations, and software implementation; licensing or royalties: Licenses for financial software deployed by clients
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses issuer disclosures and intermediary records to manage shareholder communications and voting for issuers and financial firms; software / platform: Processes market, trade, account, and portfolio data for banks, brokers, and investment managers; distributor: Delivers issuer and fund disclosures to shareholders on behalf of issuers and intermediaries

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Investor communications, governance, capital markets processing, wealth and investment management technology, and fund analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving issuers, funds, banks, broker-dealers, and investment managers; partners / resellers: Broker-dealers, banks, and custodians connecting issuer communications and voting services to investors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC and FINRA proxy and disclosure rules, SEC transfer agent registration for applicable operations, and data privacy requirements
